decisions.reason: As a flagship organic multi-variant line aligned with the firm's organic expansion strategy and still visible on the website, the option retains strategic value at low incremental cost on existing slicing and curing capacity.
The premium snack line was extended with new variants in 2024, signaling positive early results that justify further commitment, though its move from its own page to a mention adds some uncertainty.
Launched only in 2024 and close to established boiled sausage know-how, its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so the option should stay open.

This new organic poultry slice line fits the organic growth direction and has not yet had time to reveal its value, though the earlier withdrawal of organic poultry mini salami warns that poultry organic items can underperform.
